FRAME 1 CARD: "WI-FI OFF"

ASK (one): "Comment POS"

## 3. SHOT LIST - RECORD THESE, IN ORDER
  0:00-0:02    | Frame 1: real hand flipping a phone's Wi-Fi toggle; navy frame, gold crosshair, coords in mono
                 | ON SCREEN / SPOKEN: I turn off the Wi-Fi.
                 | MOTION: hard cut, 0.3s snap, no fade

  0:09-0:13    | Thermal receipt sliding up, DEMO label, M-PESA row, then a gold SYNCED pill on the phone
                 | ON SCREEN / SPOKEN: Receipt now. Sync on reconnect.
                 | MOTION: receipt slides 1.1s, pill pops 0.3s
  0:13-0:16    | Paper section, big Fraunces line, one gold hand-drawn underline, keyword in mono

                 | MOTION: night -> paper cut at 0.6s

RECORDING NOTES
- Screen record at 1080x1920 or crop a 1440p capture; hide bookmarks, cursor
  halos, notifications and your desktop wallpaper.
- Every code line must be real text from the source above. Never let an AI
  model generate a code frame. If a line is illustrative, keep its label.
- Capture the Wi-Fi toggle, the receipt and the SYNCED state for real. A
  simulated state is fine only if the caption says DEMO, as on the receipt.
- Hold each shot 2.5s maximum. Cut on the beat; do not Ken Burns a still.
- Frame 1 must move. No static title card, no logo sting.

EDIT ORDER
1. Lay the hook shot at 0:00. Trim all pre-roll.
2. Add the on-screen card at frame 1 (Fraunces 120px, six words or fewer).
3. Add code/receipt/phone plates, each <= 2.5s, with a 0.3s snap between them.
4. Burn in captions line by line, 44px Inter, inside y=230..1440.
5. Add the audio listed below. Duck nothing; there is no music bed.
6. Night -> paper section change once, at the timecode in the shot list.
7. Last frame: one keyword. Nothing else. Loop the first word if possible.

## 4. BRAND BLOCK
BRAND (non-negotiable, from the client's own design tokens):
Vertical 9:16, 1080x1920. Navy #071022 background, paper #f7f6f2 text,
gold #eab308 as the ONE accent at night, violet #7c3aed as the ONE
accent on paper sections. Contour lines #7c3aed on navy, #10265c
on paper, opacity 0.12-0.35, drifting slowly. Muted metadata #a3aecb.
Type: Fraunces (display serif, italic for exactly one word), Inter (body),
JetBrains Mono (code, numbers, coordinates). No other fonts.
Signature marks: "6.7924° S, 39.2083° E" in mono top-right; ACT 01 / MIZIZI style
mono kicker; a glass panel behind long copy; a real code window with line
numbers; a thermal receipt or a phone showing SYNCED; one hand-drawn underline.
Motion: 0.3s / 0.6s / 1.1s, ease cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),
transform + opacity only, a visible frame change every 2.5s or sooner.
Bilingual: Kiswahili for the human line, English for the technical line.
Never translate the same sentence twice on one frame.
No logo animation, no intro card, no "who we are" slide.
Safe zone (Reels): y 230..1440, keep right 230px clear. Safe zone (carousels): 120px clear on every side.

## 5. AUDIO
No music under the first 2 seconds. One UI click on the Wi-Fi toggle, one thermal printer click under the receipt, low room tone. Kiswahili TTS voiceover demo: 5 clips in audio/*.wav assembled by render_reel_v2.py; burn in captions.

## 6. NEGATIVE PROMPT
NEGATIVE / DO NOT GENERATE:
generic purple-blue gradient, glassmorphism blobs, floating 3D UI cards, glowing globe or hologram, binary rain, matrix code, hooded hacker, person typing on a laptop in a dark room, stock photo of a smiling team, rocket ship, lightbulb, AI sparkle icon, neon cyberpunk city, dashboard with random fake KPIs, unreadable garbled code, invented syntax, confetti, lens flare, slow drone shot, Ken Burns on a still screenshot over 2s, emoji bullets, seamless, revolutionize, game-changer, unlock, leverage, in today's fast-paced world, follow for more, stop scrolling, hashtag wall, more than one call to action, a URL on screen, logo sting, invented client name, invented percentage, invented testimonial.

## 7. QA GATE
QA GATE (do not accept the clip until all pass):
  [ ] Frame 1 shows a real artifact, not a greeting or a preamble.
  [ ] A visible frame change happens at least every 2.5 seconds.
  [ ] Exactly one large number, and it is in SOURCE OF TRUTH.
  [ ] Colours are navy/paper with ONE accent. No gradient.
  [ ] Code is readable and came from the repo/tokens, not the model.
  [ ] The first line is Kiswahili; the technical line is English.
  [ ] Captions are burned in (most viewers start muted).
  [ ] ONE ask at the end, and the keyword is spoken.
  [ ] Nothing from the NEGATIVE list appears.
  [ ] No client name, percentage or unverified testimonial.
  [ ] No URL on screen, no logo sting.
  [ ] Checked on a phone at 1080x1920 with the sound off.
